name: factograph
description: Answers from facts people approved, every claim linked to the fact behind it - read public knowledge stores, or keep a person's own.

interface.longDescription:
FactoGraph keeps knowledge as facts a person approved, each with its own link, and answers questions only from those facts, citing every claim and checking the answer against them.

With this plugin ChatGPT can read any public FactoGraph store: list its facts, or ask it a question and get an answer whose sentences link to the facts they rest on. Without a store link it reads the FactoGraph guide, a public store about FactoGraph itself. When a person wants their own memory that lasts across conversations, ChatGPT can make them a store (only after they say yes); its private link is theirs, and ChatGPT passes it to the tools to keep the facts they approve there - in this conversation or a later one where they give the link again.

Public stores are read-only: nothing can be added, changed or deleted in one. In a private store, nothing is stored without the person's approval, and nothing is deleted without their confirmation. FactoGraph runs no language model of its own: ChatGPT does the reading, and the store checks the answer.
defaultPrompt: What is FactoGraph and how do I use it?
List every fact in the FactoGraph guide store.
Make me a FactoGraph store to remember facts I approve.

review.commerce_description: No payments, purchases or product sales: FactoGraph is free and keeps and reads knowledge stores.

positive.description: Explains FactoGraph from its public guide store, with cited facts.
positive.prompt: What is FactoGraph and how do I use it with ChatGPT?
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the guide store's manual, asks it the question, answers the step's prompts, and replies with an answer whose sentences link to the guide's facts.

positive.description: Asks a given public store a question and cites its facts.
positive.prompt: Ask the store https://api.factograph.app/api/p/16e45364-ac11-457a-b2de-923fd31133bb what a store link is, with sources.
positive.expected_behavior: Answers only from that store's facts and shows each claim with a link to the fact it rests on.

positive.description: Lists every fact in a public store.
positive.prompt: List every fact in the FactoGraph guide store.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the store's facts, numbered, each number a link to its fact.

positive.description: Makes the person a store of their own after they agree.
positive.prompt: I want you to remember facts I approve across our chats - make me a FactoGraph store.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a new empty store and gives the person its private link once, telling them to keep it private.

positive.description: Keeps a fact the person approves in the store just made for them.
positive.prompt: Make me a FactoGraph store, then remember that my project's deadline is 15 November.
positive.expected_behavior: Makes the store, proposes the fact and shows it to the person, and stores it only after they approve it, citing the stored fact's link.

negative.description: Creative writing unrelated to stored facts.
negative.prompt: Write me a poem about autumn.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call any FactoGraph tool; ChatGPT writes the poem itself, since nothing is asked of a knowledge store.
Does not call any FactoGraph tool; ChatGPT answers 391 itself, since arithmetic needs no stored facts.

negative.description: Summarising text the person pasted needs no store.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call any FactoGraph tool and stores nothing; ChatGPT summarises the pasted text itself, unless the person asks to keep facts from it.

publication.release_notes: First release: read public FactoGraph stores, ask them questions and get answers that link every claim to an approved fact, list a store's facts, make a store of your own, and keep the facts you approve in it through its private link.
